training_features.1: mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
training_features.2: rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
training_features.3: tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
training_features.4: geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
training_features.5: iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
training_features.6: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
training_features.7: geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
training_features.8: geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
training_features.9: tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
training_features.10: deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
training_features.11: iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
training_features.12: det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
training_features.13: iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
training_features.14: tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
training_features.15: depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
training_features.16: ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
training_features.17: cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
training_features.18: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
training_features.19: det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

source: read from GeoTIFF band descriptions (this session)
